meta.name: graphql-architect
meta.description: Use when designing GraphQL schemas, implementing Apollo Federation, or building real-time subscriptions. Invoke for schema design, resolvers with DataLoader, query optimization, federation directives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计 GraphQL schema 并优化查询性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在构建或维护 GraphQL API
copy.tagline_en: Design GraphQL schemas and optimize query performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building or maintaining a GraphQL API

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按架构师流程设计 GraphQL 接口:先梳理业务领域,产出类型/联合等 schema 定义,用 DataLoader 写解析器,检查多个子服务能否组合成一个图,并加上查询复杂度、深度限制、字段权限等安全措施;随后给出示例查询与设计说明。
howto.when: 当任务涉及设计 GraphQL schema、实现 Apollo Federation、搭建实时订阅等 GraphQL 架构工作时会触发;在要求优化查询、使用 DataLoader 等场景也会接管。

say.text: 帮我为电商业务设计一个 GraphQL 订单 schema。
say.note: Claude 会给出类型定义、字段说明和查询示例。

say.text: 用 DataLoader 重写这个解析器,避免 N+1 查询。
say.note: Claude 会提供批量加载的 DataLoader 实现。

say.text: 检查这两个子图能否通过 @key 完成联邦合成。
say.note: Claude 会跑组合校验并指出不一致处。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude follows an architect workflow: domain mapping, SDL schema design, DataLoader resolvers, federation composition checks, security limits, and outputs examples plus design notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when designing GraphQL schemas, implementing Apollo Federation, building real-time subscriptions, or optimizing queries and DataLoader usage.

say_en.text: Design a GraphQL order schema for an e-commerce app.
say_en.note: Returns SDL type definitions and example queries.

say_en.text: Rewrite this resolver with DataLoader to avoid N+1.
Check whether these subgraphs pass federation composition via @key.
say_en.note: Runs composition validation and reports mismatches.
